privacy.title: 隱私權政策
privacy.lead: 說明 0x6.ai 網站與各項作品如何處理你的資料。簡單說：我們不要求登入、不放廣告、不做追蹤分析，也不販售任何資料。
privacy.updated: 最後更新：2026 年 10 月 9 日
privacy.s1d: 瀏覽作品不需要帳號，也不會要求你填寫個人資料。
privacy.s2d: 不使用廣告、追蹤 Cookie 或第三方分析工具。
privacy.s3d: 不出售、出租或交換任何可識別你身分的資料。
privacy.p1: 本政策適用於 0x6.ai 經營的網站與作品，包括：
privacy.p1b: x.0x6.ai：X 動態新聞
privacy.p1c: 於 LINE STORE 販售的貼圖與表情貼
privacy.p1d: 之後新增的作品若沒有另外的隱私說明，也適用本政策。
privacy.p2: 我們的網站與作品都可以匿名使用，不提供註冊、登入、留言或表單功能，因此不會主動蒐集你的姓名、Email、電話等個人資料。只有在你主動寫信聯絡我們時，才會收到你提供的 Email 地址與信件內容，並且只用來回覆你。
privacy.p3: 和所有網站一樣，你的瀏覽器在連線時會送出 IP 位址、瀏覽器類型、作業系統、請求時間與造訪的網址等技術資料。這些資料可能由下方列出的主機與網路服務商依其政策記錄，用於安全防護、除錯與維持服務運作。我們不會用這些資料辨識你的身分或建立個人檔案。
privacy.p4: 本站不設定 Cookie。我們只用瀏覽器的 localStorage 記住你選擇的介面語言（EN 或繁中），這筆設定只存在你的裝置上，不會傳回伺服器。你可以隨時從瀏覽器設定清除。
privacy.p5: 為了提供網站內容，你的瀏覽器會直接連線到以下服務，它們會依各自的隱私權政策處理連線資料：
privacy.p5b: LINE：作品預覽圖由 LINE 的圖片伺服器提供；點擊作品卡會前往 LINE STORE。
privacy.p5d: X：x.0x6.ai 顯示的頭像與圖片可能由 X 的伺服器提供；點擊貼文會前往 X。
privacy.p5e: 離開本站前往第三方網站後，請以該網站的隱私權政策為準。在 LINE STORE 購買貼圖時，付款與帳號資料由 LINE 處理，我們不會取得。
privacy.p6: 我們只為了提供、維護與改善網站和作品，或回覆你的來信而使用資料。我們不會出售、出租或交換任何可識別你身分的資料給其他個人、企業或機關，除非依法律要求必須提供。
privacy.p7: 本站全程使用 HTTPS 加密連線。因為我們幾乎不保存個人資料，可能受影響的範圍也很小；來信會保存在受保護的信箱帳號中，不再需要時即刪除。
privacy.p8: 我們的服務不是專為兒童設計，也不會在知情的情況下蒐集兒童的個人資料。如果你認為孩子曾提供個人資料給我們，請聯絡我們刪除。
privacy.p9: 依中華民國《個人資料保護法》及你所在地區的相關法規，你可以要求查詢、閱覽、更正或刪除我們持有的你的個人資料，或撤回先前的同意。請透過下方聯絡方式來信，我們會盡快處理。
privacy.p10: 本政策可能因服務內容或法規調整而修正，修正後會公布在本頁並更新上方的最後更新日期。重大變更時，我們會在網站上另外標示。

privacy.metaDesc: How 0x6.ai handles data on its website and works.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.lead: How the 0x6.ai website and works handle your data. In short: no sign-in, no ads, no tracking analytics, and we never sell any data.
privacy.s1d: You can browse every work without an account or any personal details.
privacy.s2d: No ads, tracking cookies, or third-party analytics.
privacy.s3d: We never sell, rent, or trade data that identifies you.
privacy.p1: This policy covers the websites and works run by 0x6.ai, including:
privacy.p1b: x.0x6.ai, the X News Feed
privacy.p1c: Stickers and emoji sold on the LINE STORE
privacy.p1d: New works without their own privacy notice are covered by this policy too.
privacy.p2: Our websites and works can be used anonymously. There is no registration, sign-in, comment, or form feature, so we do not collect your name, email, phone number, or other personal data. We only receive your email address and message when you choose to write to us, and we use them only to reply.
privacy.p3: As with any website, your browser sends technical data such as your IP address, browser type, operating system, request time, and the URL visited. The hosting and network providers listed below may log this data under their own policies for security, debugging, and keeping the service running. We do not use it to identify you or build a profile of you.
privacy.p4: This site does not set cookies. We only use your browser's localStorage to remember the interface language you chose (EN or Traditional Chinese). That setting stays on your device and is never sent to a server, and you can clear it any time in your browser settings.
privacy.p5: To show the site's content, your browser connects directly to these services, which handle connection data under their own privacy policies:
privacy.p5b: LINE serves the work preview images, and the work card links to the LINE STORE.
privacy.p5c: Cloudflare provides network and security services for x.0x6.ai.
privacy.p5d: X may serve the avatars and images shown on x.0x6.ai, and posts link to X.
privacy.p5e: Once you leave for a third-party site, that site's privacy policy applies. When you buy stickers on the LINE STORE, LINE handles your payment and account details; we never receive them.
privacy.h6: How data is used and shared
privacy.p6: We use data only to provide, maintain, and improve the website and works, or to reply to your messages. We never sell, rent, or trade data that identifies you to any person, company, or agency, unless the law requires it.
privacy.p7: The site is served over HTTPS throughout. Because we keep almost no personal data, very little could be affected; messages you send are kept in a protected mailbox and deleted once no longer needed.
privacy.p8: Our services are not designed for children, and we do not knowingly collect children's personal data. If you believe a child has given us personal data, contact us and we will delete it.
privacy.p9: Under Taiwan's Personal Data Protection Act and the laws where you live, you can ask to access, review, correct, or delete personal data we hold about you, or withdraw consent you gave earlier. Email us using the contact below and we will handle it promptly.
privacy.p10: We may update this policy when our services or the law change. Updates are posted on this page with a new last-updated date, and significant changes will be highlighted on the site.
privacy.p11: For questions about this policy or to exercise your rights, email nctu6.tw@gmail.com.
